name: Hachigatsu no Junkyouchi
source:
A world demon possession incidents become frequent.
Main character is an inquisitor specializing in exorcism. After attacks of the Devil Kings he seals his right eye and starts his crusade.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是一个恶魔附身事件频发的世界。
主人公是一名专门驱魔的宗教裁判官。遭到魔王们袭击后，他封印了自己的右眼，踏上讨伐之路。
